svg.title: Libya: Areas of Control
svg.desc: Situation map covering 8.7°E to 25.8°E, 18.9°N to 34.2°N. Schematic · approximate, First Libyan Civil War ~spring 2011 (after UNSCR 1973) · open-source reporting, not operational intelligence. Areas of control in 3 classes: Gaddafi loyalists, Rebels / NTC, Contested (oil crescent) (contested). Marked: Contested / besieged (approx.). The map draws the assessment it was given; it does not verify who holds what.
